items.citation_text: ARH Appoints Pierre Noel as Interim President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Pierre Noel was appointed Interim President and CEO, effective July 13, 2026.

items.citation_text: Public Statement: Jeremy Stevenson stepped down as President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH announced that Jeremy Stevenson stepped down as President and CEO on June 2, 2026.

items.citation_text: Interim CEO announcement confirming Raeline McGrath's acting service
items.verbatim_snippet: A subsequent ARH announcement confirms that Raeline McGrath served as Acting President and CEO for the intervening weeks, in addition to her Vice President of Patient Care and Chief Nursing Executive role, before Pierre Noel’s appointment.

items.citation_text: ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: ARH and Queensway Carleton Hospital announced that QCH Chief of Staff Dr. Kathi Kovacs would also become ARH’s Chief of Staff under a joint model, effective August 1, 2025.

items.citation_text: ARH and QCH to Implement Joint Chief of Staff
items.verbatim_snippet: She succeeded Dr. Florin Padeanu, who had served as ARH Chief of Staff since 2022.

items.citation_text: ARH Board celebrates long-serving directors and appoints new director and committee member
items.verbatim_snippet: Five directors concluded their service: Barb Darlow, Board Chair from 2015 to 2021; Donna Anderson, a director since 2013 and former Governance Committee Chair and Board Vice-Chair; Barbara Kieley, who had chaired the Resources Planning and Audit Committee; Mark MacGown; and Tyler Pirie, who had chaired the Quality Committee.

items.citation_text: Arnprior Regional Health will welcome new President and CEO this fall
items.verbatim_snippet: The Board appointed Leah Levesque as the next President and CEO. She was scheduled to begin October 1, 2021, succeeding Eric Hanna, whose final day after 13 years leading ARH was September 30, 2021.
